channel.title: Osaurus (Intel)
channel.description: Updates for Osaurus (Intel) — the cloud-powered Intel Mac fork.

item.description:
## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.35
- Restores recovery-phrase identity flows and safely migrates imported plaintext storage on Intel Macs. - Reconstructs Knowledge with local indexing, search, refresh, collection grants, and project integration. - Restores the full Projects workspace with instructions, shared Knowledge, per-chat working folders, default agents, and project memory. - Repairs Intel memory visibility, consolidation, namespace inspection, and project-scoped recall. - Makes OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth work across setup, model discovery, streaming, follow-ups, cancellation, and relaunch while filtering unsupported models. - Adds Claude Code subscription routing with visible streaming activity and authorized file, editing, notebook, and shell tools inside selected working folders. - Fixes provider-qualified model ownership, agent default-model selection, Osaurus Router model discovery, restored-chat headers, app icon behavior, and Ventura window polish.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.24.7 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.34
Projects now have a real page. Clicking a project opens it in the main window — shared instructions, its chat list, and a New Chat button — instead of a modal you could only close. Chats inside a project show a chip in the toolbar that takes you back, and project membership is now visible on every chat in the sidebar.
Fixed: project instructions could move between projects. Creating or switching projects could write one project's instructions onto another and blank the original. Instructions are now bound to a single project by construction. Chats that appeared to ignore their project's instructions were hitting the same bug.
Fixed: window chrome overlapped the project page. The agent picker and New Chat button no longer render on top of a project's title.
Fixed: multi-select showed no selection. Command-click and Shift-click now highlight the chats they select.
Fixed: duplicated message buttons. Copy, edit and delete rendered twice on your own messages.
Fixed: the right-click menu and the actions popover offered different items in different orders. Both now match, and the Export entry — which could never work in this build — is gone.
Also fixed: slash commands never appeared when typing /; assistant messages had no copy or regenerate row; Command-F and Escape did nothing; /clear did nothing; chats stopped naming themselves automatically.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.33
Restores the chat sessions that disappeared after 1.0.32. They were never lost — a new field made older session files unreadable, so they were skipped on load. They come back on first launch, untouched.
Server settings are reachable again. The whole Server → Settings tab was previously hidden behind an "Apple Silicon only" notice, which was wrong: port, CORS, authentication and proxy have nothing to do with the chip. You can now change the port the local server listens on, and it takes effect without relaunching. Related: the server had been ignoring your saved port and always binding to the built-in one.
Settings sidebar is organised into groups — Models, Capabilities, Automation, Developer Tools, General — with anything this Mac can't run gathered at the bottom instead of scattered through the list. Providers is now "Cloud Models" and Models is "Local Models", which says something truer about how this build works.
If a provider ever loses access to its stored API key, the app now says so in the log instead of quietly behaving as though no key was ever saved. Previously that produced an empty model list and a bare Retry button with no explanation.
Plugin downloads now honour your proxy settings properly, including the host and port checks the rest of the app already applied.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.32
Projects — group related chats under a shared set of instructions. Create a project from the sidebar, drop existing chats into it, write the instructions once, and every chat in that project carries them. Instructions ride the same context path as memory recall, so they cost you nothing in prompt-cache reuse.
Your chat history got a lot more workable: full-text search with an in-chat find bar, pinned chats, multi-select for bulk archive and delete, automatic titles (now optional) plus /title on demand, and the ability to delete an individual response. You can also bring conversations in from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and OpenWebUI, including zipped exports. The sidebar resizes, ⌘N opens a new chat, and ⌘= / ⌘- zoom the text.
Lost access to a Mac? Identity restore from your recovery phrase is now reachable in Settings, and it reports exactly what it re-derived and what it could not.
Security: in release builds the Osaurus Router endpoint can no longer be redirected by a local preference. Previously any process able to write this app's defaults could point billed inference somewhere else.
Reliability: a batch of upstream crash and hang fixes — settings windows, management sheets, the find bar, display reconfiguration, text rendering — plus keychain hardening so credentials survive a relaunch, and providers that no longer get stuck disconnected after an update.
MCP servers are considerably tougher: sessions recover and retry instead of failing, OAuth refresh no longer stampedes, tool discovery follows pagination instead of silently keeping the first page, auth failures are classified rather than generic, and stdio servers report why they died.
Privacy: provider model discovery and plugin downloads now honour your configured proxy. Both previously went around it.
Math renders properly now — inline $…$ and display blocks, without the delimiters leaking through or the layout jumping.
Absorbs selected fixes and features from upstream 0.21 through 0.24.3. This is a curated subset, not a full sync — the fork continues to leave out subsystems that need Apple Silicon.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.31
Local memory — Phase 2. Your conversations are now distilled into durable episodes, pinned facts, and an evolving identity profile, then recalled into context when relevant — layered on top of the existing transcript recall. All on-device and encrypted; no Apple Silicon required.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.30
Memory fixes:
• Recall now actually works — conversation turns are stored when Memory is enabled (a leftover flag was silently keeping the write path off, so nothing was ever saved to recall). • Memory tab icon now shows on Ventura.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.29
New: on-device semantic memory 🧠
Osaurus can now remember your conversations and automatically recall the relevant bits when you chat.
• Open Settings → Memory to turn it on. • Choose an embedding backend: On-device (a small model that runs entirely on this Mac — no cloud, click Download once ~30 MB), Cloud (use a provider's embeddings API), or Off (encrypted keyword search only). • Everything is stored encrypted on your Mac. The on-device option needs no internet after the one-time model download. • Set how much recalled context to inject per message, or clear all memory, from the same tab.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.28
Two fixes — and the first build signed with a stable identity:
• Osaurus Router models now load on startup. Before, only your DeepSeek models showed in the picker until you opened the Credits tab; the router's catalog needs a signed fetch that now runs at launch. • The provider edit sheet's 'Test' button now works for the Osaurus Router (it validates via the signed catalog instead of erroring). • Signing: builds are now signed with a stable certificate instead of ad-hoc. This is a ONE-TIME re-authorization — after you allow the keychain prompts on this update, future updates will stop asking.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.27
Three fixes:
• Model picker: direct-provider models (e.g. your own DeepSeek) no longer borrow the Osaurus Router's venice pricing when they share a model id — pricing now only shows for actual router models. • Pasted-content chip: restored the third button that drops the pasted text into the message box (alongside edit and remove). • Settings window now uses the Osaurus titlebar style instead of a plain macOS title bar.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.26
Model picker now matches the original Osaurus design:
• Each model shows a description line — underlying provider, input/output price, and context window (e.g. 'venice · $1.15/M in · $2.30/M out · 128K ctx'). • Vision-capable models show a Vision badge. • New header buttons: Add Provider, and a Sort & Filter control (sort by price, filter by minimum context or vision) on the Osaurus tab.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.25
Two fixes for hosted inference and the model picker:
• Osaurus Router chat now works — requests were hitting the wrong path (/chat/completions instead of /v1/chat/completions) and failing with a 404. Selecting a router model and sending a message now routes correctly. • Model picker rebuilt — it now scrolls properly, has a search field and source tabs (e.g. Osaurus / DeepSeek), and shows a Vision badge for vision-capable models. The old picker couldn't scroll with a large catalog.
Also: provider errors now name the actual provider instead of always saying 'DeepSeek'.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.24
Synced upstream 0.20.3 networking improvements: the model router, theme gallery, chat remote-image downloads, and plugin-manifest fetches now honor a configured global proxy. Plumbing-only — no behavior change unless you set a proxy in Settings.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.23
Absorbs upstream fixes through 0.20.3: configurable Hugging Face cache path, local access-key lifecycle improvements, OAuth requests routed through the global proxy + Codex OAuth diagnostics, and a main-thread perf fix (cached date formatter). Translations updated.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.3 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.22
Adds the /agent slash command — type /agent in the composer to quickly switch agents. The model picker now prunes external models you've deleted on disk. Experimental: hosted 'Osaurus Router' inference — a new Credits tab in the Manage window lets you use Osaurus's hosted models, billed to your Osaurus identity (requires funding a router account).
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.0 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.21
Absorbs upstream Osaurus fixes through 0.20.0: faster and more accurate tokens/sec, better image context-token estimates, a raw-JSON theme editor plus a theme-editor performance fix, and a batch of main-thread hang/crash fixes (clipboard, quit and plugin teardown, watcher, tool handling). Chat no longer jumps to the top when a response finishes, and renaming a chat in the sidebar now sticks. Updated translations.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.20.0 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.20
DeepSeek prompt caching now works on long and tool-heavy chats — big token-cost savings. Fixes the chat layout on macOS Ventura: in very long chats the message box stays reachable, text no longer slips behind the header or composer, and the conversation minimap stays within the message area and scrolls when expanded.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.19
Fixed a prompt-cache regression: tool-using conversations (especially long ones restored from older builds) were re-billing their full history on every turn because backfilled tool-call ids were randomized each request. They're now deterministic, so the provider's prompt cache (DeepSeek et al.) holds across turns — big token-cost savings on long agentic chats.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.18
🎉 Now runs natively on macOS 13 (Ventura) — the minimum macOS dropped from Sonoma to Ventura, giving a second life to even more Intel Macs that can't (or won't) run a newer OS via OpenCore Legacy Patcher. Also fixed: when you set a working folder, the agent now gets the file tools (read/edit/search/tree) and shell access in every tool-selection mode, not just Auto.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.17
Now runs on macOS 14 (Sonoma) — the minimum dropped from Sequoia to Sonoma, reaching more Intel Macs (native Ventura support is in progress). Also: the Plugins → Installed tab now shows an Update badge + an in-card Update action when a plugin has a newer version available.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.16
Plugin updates are now detected: when an installed plugin has a newer version in the plugin repository, the Plugins tab shows an Upgrade button and an update-count badge — and upgrading clears it. (The Search plugin just shipped 1.1.0 with a resilient multi-engine cascade — open Plugins → Installed to upgrade.)
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.15
- 🔒 Security: provider API keys and MCP/GitHub tokens are now stored under a fork-private Keychain entry, so the Intel build can never clobber the keys of a co-installed official Osaurus on the same Mac. **After updating, re-enter your cloud API key once** (Settings → Providers → edit → paste key) — it's moving to the isolated entry. - 📖 Restored the Intel README (an upstream sync had overwritten it) and added a "Run a model locally" guide for llama.cpp / Bonsai.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.14
- 🔀 Settings → Providers: you can now reorder providers. With more than one provider, a reorder button appears in the header — drag to set the order, which is reflected in the list and the chat model picker.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.13
- 📊 The context-budget popover now breaks the system prompt into named rails — Persona, Grounding (working folder), Agent Loop, Plugin Instructions — alongside Tools / Conversation / Output, instead of a single "System Prompt" line. More detail, matching the Apple-Silicon build's granularity.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.12
- 🧹 Tools tab: fixed plugins showing up twice (and both expanding when you clicked one). - 🏷️ Plugins → Installed: removed the redundant "Native — this fork" section header.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.11
- 🧩 Plugins → Installed: every plugin now uses one consistent card design (and opens the same rich detail page with per-tool descriptions). Fixes the first-load flicker where cards changed style after a second. - 🧹 Tools tab: the blank gaps between cards no longer come back after you switch tabs and return.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.10
- 🧹 Tools tab: removed the large blank gaps between plugin cards. - 📄 Plugin detail pages now list each tool with its description (the registry plugins are now as informative as the native ones). - 🗑️ Native "this-fork" plugins now have an Uninstall option (three-dots menu + a trash button on the detail page).
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.9
- 🔧 Tools tab now also lists your locally-installed native plugins and their tools under Available, so you can set Ask / Deny / Auto on them. - 🏷️ Plugins: the Installed tab now reads "Loaded" consistently (it's loaded + active); "Installed" appears in Browse to mark plugins you already have. - ℹ️ About panel now shows the upstream-sync era in the version line — e.g. "1.0.9 · upstream 0.19.15". - 🎨 Fixed the app icon's black corners — the squircle now has proper transparent corners.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.8
**Plugins** - 🔌 Fixed installed plugins appearing twice (a "Loaded" card *and* an "Installed" card). Each installed plugin now shows once, with an uninstall option. - 🚫 Apple-Silicon-only plugins can no longer be "installed" on Intel (the three-dots menu correctly hides Install — Intel can't load an arm64 dylib).
**Tools** - 🔧 An installed plugin's tools now appear in Tools → Available, so you can set per-tool Ask / Deny / Auto policies. (Previously the tools worked in chat but the tab was empty.)
**About** - 🏷️ The status panel now shows the build's upstream-sync era — e.g. "v1.0.8 · upstream 0.19.15" — with the exact synced commit in the tooltip.
_Intel fork · synced to upstream Osaurus 0.19.15 — see UPSTREAM_SYNC.md._

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.7
- 🧩 The chat model picker is now fully provider-driven — no hardcoded models. Every model comes from the providers you configure in Settings → Providers (a local llama.cpp/Ollama server, DeepSeek, OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Add a provider, its models appear; remove it, they're gone. - 🌳 This is the distributable shape: run Osaurus on an Intel Mac with only a local model, only a cloud key, or both side by side.

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.6
- 🌳 Configured providers now actually show their models. The app probes each enabled provider's /models endpoint (at launch, when you open the Providers tab, and after add/edit) and caches the result — so a local llama.cpp server (Bonsai), Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint shows a real model count AND appears in the chat model picker. Fixes "0 models available" and the picker only ever listing DeepSeek. - 🚇 Selecting one of those models routes the request to that provider (its own URL + auth — no-auth local servers included), not DeepSeek. - 🔄 Auto-updater retargeted to the renamed repo (osaurus-intel).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.5
- 🌳 Local + custom models now work end-to-end. The chat model picker lists every model from your configured providers (Settings → Providers) — a local llama.cpp server (e.g. Bonsai), Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — not just the built-in DeepSeek tiers. - 🚇 Chat requests now route to the provider that owns the selected model (its own URL + auth, including no-auth local servers), instead of always going to DeepSeek. - 🔄 Newly added or edited providers appear in the picker immediately — no relaunch.

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.4
- 🔐 Tool-permission prompt is now the real Osaurus card (icon, description, formatted arguments, Allow / Deny / Always Allow, esc/return shortcuts) instead of a plain system dialog. - 🎹 Fixed: setting a new global hotkey + Save now actually replaces the old one (previously the re-registration was silently skipped on Intel).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.3
- 🎹 Global hotkey now summons the chat window from ANY app (activates Osaurus + moves the window to the active Space) — fixes the "nothing happens from another app / gets stuck" case. Press again while it's frontmost to hide it. - 🔐 Richer tool-approval dialog: shows the tool description + formatted arguments, with Allow / Deny / Always Allow (Always Allow sets the tool to Auto so it won't ask again).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.2
Bug-fix release.
- 📊 Context-budget popover now shows the full breakdown (System Prompt + Tools + Conversation) on restored sessions, not just typing tokens. - 🏷️ Model-generated chat titles fixed (completeChat now honors max_tokens + disables reasoning). - 🔐 Tool permissions persist across restart AND are enforced: Deny blocks a tool, Ask shows a confirmation before running. - 🎹 Added diagnostics to the global hotkey (still being chased — run from Terminal to see why it isn't firing).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.1
First published build — cloud-powered Osaurus running natively on Intel Macs (x86_64).
- Cloud chat (DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible) with live reasoning + tool-call streaming - Native x86_64 plugins, folder context, schedules, watchers, themes, agents, MCP tools - Global hotkey, identity sync, persisted settings, smart chat titles - Auto-updates now flow from this repo
